roleContext.roleTitle: Financial Crime Data Analyst, Transaction Screening
roleContext.jobDescription: The transaction screening team tunes and monitors the sanctions and payment screening rules for the bank's payment flows. The Financial Crime Data Analyst analyses the screening alert outcomes, proposes rule and list changes with their expected alert volumes, prepares the monthly screening effectiveness pack, presents proposals to the screening governance forum, and documents each change's boundaries. Rule changes are approved by the forum. The role requires defending proposals in the forum when the compliance members challenge them. Reports to the head of screening analytics; works with the screening operations team, compliance and the list management vendor.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Financial Crime Data Analyst, Transaction Screening

## Experience

- Financial crime data analyst in a bank's transaction screening team for three years, analysing the screening alert outcomes each week and proposing rule and list changes with their expected alert volumes.
- Prepared the monthly screening effectiveness pack under the pack standard, with the packs filed in the screening governance repository.
- Presented twenty-seven proposals to the screening governance forum; the forum minutes record the compliance members' challenges on each and the forum's decision, with twenty-two proposals approved as presented and five amended.
- Coordinated the approved rule changes with the screening operations team through the change note, recording which checks were mine and which were operations'; the approvals were the forum's.
- Wrote the limitation section and the hand-over conditions of each change note.

## Work samples

- Work sample: two proposals with their forum minutes and decisions, one monthly screening effectiveness pack and one change note with its limitation section, with the governance repository references as a verification trail.
